messages:
nina: Quick sync: runtime v2.4 rollout tonight. Canary 1% then ramp. Need console & router handshake + telemetry gate. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. cc @olivia @sanjay

olivia: ack. will stage console flag flips. which telemetry thresholds?

sanjay: router must accept legacy and new header x-rw-model for 30m post-canary. header-swap test planned.

nina: gates: runtime_p95 <230ms, gen_errors <0.9%, no kv_eviction spike >2x. breach -> immediate pin to v2.3.

paul: deploy-bot preflight shows reserved GPUs ok. console schema needs small tolerance change for extra meta field.

olivia: applying graceful-parse patch at 01:58 then opt-in flag at 02:05.

deploy-bot: starting canary at 1739997020. canary=1% eu.

ops-oncall: alert rules set: "runtime_gen_error_rate > 0.9% for 5m" and "runtime_p95 > 300ms for 3m" -> page SEV2.

deploy-bot: +5m canary metrics: p95 205ms, gen_errors 0.3%, kv_evictions nominal. no gates tripped.

sanjay: header-swap smoke: routing 0.5% new header, 0.5% legacy. initial parse mismatch 0.02% flagged to console.

olivia: tolerance patch mitigated mismatch. documenting in release notes.

nina: proceed to staged ramp plan: 5% at 02:30, 25% at 02:45 if healthy. rollback command in runbook:
cloudctl runtime pin --service runtime --version v2.3 --reason "auto-rollback: canary breach"

paul: I'll own pin and post timestamped rollback note if needed.

ops-oncall: monitoring kv_eviction correlation with latency; will escalate on signal.

nina: any blockers?

olivia: none. flags ready.

sanjay: router ok, keeping compatibility for 1hr post-ramp.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramps: 5% at 1739997400, 25% at 1739997900. Notifying channels.

nina: thanks team. first 30m watch then full rollout signoff. :thumbsup:
